name: Sarva Mangala Mangalye
text:
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके ।
शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
meaning: Salutations to the auspicious Goddess, who helps bring worthy aims to fulfilment and offers refuge.
purpose: A widely recited Devi verse for auspiciousness and refuge.
supports: Harmony; courage; seeking support; remembering one’s own worth.
when: During a Devi-focused practice, or when seeking inner steadiness.
